messages.text:
"LA ESPADA CELESTIAL
ENCARGO MAESTRO DEFINITIVO PARA IA GAME LAB
RPG DE FANTASÍA ÉPICA — OBJETIVO: ASPIRAR A GOTY
INSTRUCCIÓN PRINCIPAL:
Quiero que desarrolles LA ESPADA CELESTIAL, un videojuego RPG de fantasía medieval, acción, aventura, exploración y criaturas coleccionables. No quiero una simple demostración, una maqueta, una presentación, una biblia de diseño ni un escenario con botones decorativos. Quiero un videojuego real, jugable, funcional, profundo, original y profesional.
La ambición es crear un título capaz de competir algún día entre los mejores videojuegos del mundo y aspirar al premio GOTY (Game of the Year).
No afirmes que el juego ha ganado o merece un premio sin haberlo conseguido. El GOTY es nuestro objetivo de excelencia, no una promesa.
Debes trabajar sobre las capacidades reales de IA Game Lab, inspeccionar el proyecto existente y utilizar las herramientas disponibles para construir el juego. No inventes funciones que la plataforma no pueda ejecutar. Si algo no es posible, explica la limitación y desarrolla la mejor alternativa técnica.
---
1. IDENTIDAD DEL VIDEOJUEGO
Nombre: LA ESPADA CELESTIAL.
Género: RPG de acción, fantasía medieval, aventura, exploración, combate y colección de criaturas.
Plataforma prioritaria: Android.
Orientación: Horizontal.
Idioma: Español de España.
Estética: Fantasía medieval cinematográfica con personalidad anime, escenarios detallados, iluminación espectacular, personajes originales y efectos visuales de alta calidad.
Inspiración: La profundidad de los grandes RPG, la libertad de exploración de las aventuras clásicas y la emoción de coleccionar criaturas, sin copiar personajes, diseños, música, historias ni propiedades intelectuales existentes.
El juego debe tener identidad propia y ser reconocible por su universo, personajes, criaturas, música y dirección artística.
---
2. OBJETIVO DE CALIDAD: NIVEL GOTY
Diseña y desarrolla el juego siguiendo estándares de excelencia en:
Jugabilidad.
Combate.
Historia.
Personajes.
Mundo.
Exploración.
Diseño artístico.
Música y sonido.
Animaciones.
Inteligencia artificial.
Interfaz y controles.
Rendimiento.
Accesibilidad.
Profundidad de sistemas.
Originalidad.
Cada sistema debe aportar algo al conjunto.
No quiero cantidad sin calidad.
No quiero un mundo enorme vacío, enemigos repetidos, misiones genéricas ni habilidades que no tengan utilidad.
Quiero una experiencia memorable.
---
3. UNIVERSO E HISTORIA
El mundo está formado por regiones conectadas por una historia épica.
Región inicial: VALDORIA
Una tierra de aldeas, bosques, praderas, ríos, montañas, ruinas y antiguas civilizaciones.
Aquí comienza la aventura.
Región de DRAKMOR
Territorios volcánicos, fortalezas, ciudades devastadas, bosques oscuros y criaturas corrompidas.
Región de KANSORDORE
Templos celestiales, ciudades antiguas, bibliotecas prohibidas, dimensiones alternativas y misterios relacionados con el origen del mundo.
Elementos fundamentales de la historia
La Gema Celestial.
La Jarra de Origen.
La Lágrima de la Primera Brasa.
La Profecía de Jugador Cero.
La Convergencia Absoluta.
El Despertar.
La Resonancia.
El Velo.
La Ruptura.
La Ascensión.
Construye una historia original, coherente y emocionante, con misterios, revelaciones, conflictos, decisiones, consecuencias, personajes memorables y un final satisfactorio.
No reveles todos los misterios al principio.
La historia debe desarrollarse mediante acontecimientos jugables, diálogos, exploración y escenas cinematográficas.
---
4. PROTAGONISTA
Crear un protagonista personalizable.
Permitir configurar, según las posibilidades técnicas:
Nombre.
Rostro.
Pelo.
Color de pelo.
Ropa.
Armadura.
Casco.
Accesorios.
Armas.
Estadísticas
Vida.
Maná.
Resistencia.
Fuerza.
Defensa.
Velocidad.
Inteligencia.
Suerte.
Cada atributo debe tener efectos medibles.
El equipamiento debe modificar las estadísticas y, cuando sea viable, la apariencia del personaje.
Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi
"

16: ## Main project file

18: The main project file is [.github/workflows/opencode.yml](.github/workflows/opencode.yml).
19: 
20: Keep the local [game issue E2E skill](.agents/skills/game-issue-e2e/SKILL.md)

22: initial OpenCode session link during E2E kickoff. Install the listener on the
23: default branch before requesting execution. Validate author access and freeze
24: the request inside Actions before starting the reusable execution job.
25: Set repository variable `OPENCODE_ACCESS=everyone` to accept any issue author
26: for labeled issues. Keep the App as a setup
27: helper. Use Actions concurrency to serialize each issue.
28: Store `branch` in an `omgithub-request:v1` JSON HTML comment to select the
29: project checkout, result base, and workflow. Let default-branch preparation
30: dispatch the selected branch. Run preparation and OpenCode in that branch run.
31: 
32: ## Shell timing
33: 
34: When writing shell scripts,
35: always add explicit per-command execution-time measurements between commands.
36: Use `/usr/bin/time -p` or a small timing helper around each meaningful command;
37: the outer command duration is not sufficient because it hides which step is
38: slow or hung. Use `/usr/bin/time` only in scripts; do not invoke it directly in
39: interactive shell commands.
40: 
41: ## Ideas
42: 
43: Store durable implementation ideas as individual Markdown files under
44: `./ideas/`, using descriptive kebab-case filenames such as
45: `ideas/opencode-oauth-env-auth.md`.
46: 
47: 
48: 
49: 
50: ## Links in handoffs
51: 
52: When a relevant URL or stable identifier exists, include a clickable Markdown
53: link in the user-facing response. Link GitHub issues, Actions runs, pull
54: requests, commits, releases, public app URLs, and Codex tasks/threads rather
55: than reporting only their numbers or plain text. For Codex tasks/threads, use
56: the `codex://threads/<thread-id>` URL format.
57: 
58: When mentioning a commit, append its relative age in hours or days.
59: 
60: ## OpenCode GitHub Actions
61: 
62: To execute an issue, create it with `OpenCode` and only mode labels explicitly requested by the user.
63: Check for a native `issues` run and successful preparation.
64: The workflow starts a temporary AgentsWeb SSH session,
65: verifies it, runs OpenCode, and cleans up the SSH session afterward.
66: 
67: When monitoring a triggered run, use `gh run watch <run-id> --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub --exit-status` for overall job status.
68: Do not use `gh run view --log` to read logs from a running task: GitHub reports that
69: logs are unavailable until completion. Use `bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>`
70: for the live Actions log over SSH. Do not use tight `for` loops around `gh run list`,
71: which needlessly consume GitHub API rate limit.
72: 
73: Free OpenCode models are limited per egress IP, not per account.
74: Treat a local `FreeUsageLimitError` 429 as local only.
75: Read the runner's own `Selected model` and provider errors before blaming quota.
76: Use `retryAfterMs` as the reset bound.
77: Run repeated V2 tests with a connected provider; do not spend the free allowance on retries.
78: 
79: Interrupting a V2 turn before the assistant message projects leaves no stopped message to save.
80: Wait for that assistant message before requiring the interrupted idle marker.
81: 
82: To connect to an issue's live worker, find its run ID with
83: `gh run list --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub --workflow opencode.yml --status in_progress`,
84: then run `bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>` to discover the host and port and SSH
85: with `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb` as shown by the helper.
86: 
87: When the user asks to check a live OpenCode workflow, always pull the runner logs
88: over SSH first, using `scripts/ssh-run-log.sh` or a targeted SSH read from the
89: same runner. Base the answer on those logs before discussing whether an action
90: is confirmed; do not lead with a generic inability-to-confirm statement when
91: live log evidence can be collected.
92: 
93: For real-time inspection from a live temporary SSH session, use the helper:
94: 
95: ```sh
96: bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>
97: ```
98: 
99: The helper discovers the temporary SSH command from the triggering issue or pull
100: request, then follows the freshest `_diag/pages` log. The runner uploads chunks from
101: `_diag/blocks` to GitHub. Do not print environment files, tokens, or private keys while
102: inspecting the runner.
103: 
104: ## Mac SSH access
105: 
106: The Mac private key stays at `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb`. Its public key is
107: stored in the repository Actions secret `AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY`. The issue
108: commented by the workflow contains a directly usable command such as:
109: 
110: ```sh
111: ssh -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb -p <port> runner@<run-name>.agentsweb.space
112: ```
113: 
114: The command works only while the corresponding Actions job is running.
115: 
116: ## Connecting to a live OpenCode worker
117: 
118: Use the repository helper to discover the worker host and port from the broker
119: or issue comment. It uses the persistent local key `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb`:
120: 
121: ```sh
122: bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id> --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub
123: ```
124: 
125: For an interactive shell, reuse the host and port printed by the helper and
126: use the same key:
127: 
128: ```sh
129: ssh -tt -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
130:   -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null \
131:   -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb \
132:   -p <port> runner@<run-name>.agentsweb.space

## Objective
- Build a real, playable Spanish-language fantasy action RPG called **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL** in the existing static web project, with Android/mobile support, aiming for exceptional quality (GOTY as aspiration, not a claim).
- The user’s prompt is in Spanish and was cut off mid-sentence; current scope includes character customization, three regions, story, combat, creatures, exploration, UI, audio, and polish.

## Requirements
- Name: **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL**; genre: action RPG, medieval fantasy, adventure, exploration, combat, creature collection.
- Android priority, horizontal orientation, Spanish from Spain, cinematic fantasy/anime aesthetic, original IP.
- Real playable game, not a mockup, design bible, or decorative demo.
- Regions: **VALDORIA**, **DRAKMOR**, **KANSORDORE**.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothing, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte with measurable effects; equipment affects stats and appearance; distinct animations.
- Story must be original, coherent, mysterious, with choices, consequences, memorable characters, and a satisfying ending.
- No false GOTY claims.
- Existing runtime serves a static `index.html` or Vite project; `capture.sh` auto-clicks a single visible button labeled `Start`/`Play` (English) then screenshots desktop 1440×900 and mobile 390×844 after 1s.

## Decisions
- Build a **2D top-down action RPG using Canvas 2D + DOM UI**, plain ES modules, no external runtime dependencies, served statically.
- Use procedural art and synthesized WebAudio music/SFX; downloaded local fonts (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`).
- Title screen will use a Spanish `JUGAR` button with `aria-label="Play"` so automated capture finds it.
- `JUGAR` opens the character creator (portrait-friendly), not directly gameplay; gameplay will show a rotate-device hint in portrait.
- Implement three regions, 12 collectible “Resonancias,” 11 normal enemy types, 3 bosses, 3 endings, 12 skill nodes, equipment, shops, forge, quests, codex, map, save slots, settings, accessibility, and PWA support.
- Story final choice: **Restaurar el Velo**, **Romper el Velo**, or **Convergencia Absoluta**.
- `main_awakening` starts automatically; main quests chain via `next`.
- Boss doors require puzzle flags (`val-puzzle`, `drak-runes`, `kan-library` + 3 pages).
- Plan to deliver as a mobile-friendly PWA/browser game; native APK packaging is not currently implemented and should be explained as a limitation if relevant.

- Inspected repository/runtime and verification behavior.
- Downloaded fonts to `assets/fonts/`.

- All files currently pass `node --check` as of the last check (before latest edits may need recheck).

### Active
- Building the game implementation. Next major missing pieces: `boss.js`, `companion.js`, renderer/sprites, UI/screens, main game bootstrap, `index.html`, CSS, PWA assets, title/creator screens, dialogue runner, save/load integration, testing.

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.

663: export function getNpcScript(npcId, game) {
664:   const q = game.quests;
665:   const flags = game.player.flags;
666:   const has = (id, qty = 1) => game.inventory.count(id) >= qty;
667:   switch (npcId) {
668:     case 'maren':
669:       if (q.isActive('main_roots')) return flags['val-puzzle'] ? 'maren_default' : 'maren_hint_ruins';
670:       if (q.isCompleted('main_roots')) return flags['maren_truth'] ? 'maren_default' : 'maren_after_guardian';
671:       if (q.isActive('main_shrine')) return 'maren_shrine_hint';
672:       if (!q.isCompleted('main_awakening')) return 'maren_intro';
673:       return 'maren_default';
674:     case 'lyra':
675:       if (q.isActive('main_shrine') && flags['shrine_done']) return 'lyra_shrine';
676:       if (q.isActive('main_roots') && !flags['val-puzzle']) return 'lyra_ruins';
677:       return 'lyra_default';
678:     case 'orin':
679:       if (q.isActive('side_hammer') && has('orin_hammer')) return 'orin_return_hammer';
680:       if (!q.isCompleted('side_hammer') && !q.isActive('side_hammer')) return 'orin_intro';
681:       return 'orin_default';
682:     case 'sela': return q.isCompleted('main_awakening') ? 'sela_default' : 'sela_intro';
683:     case 'elna':
684:       if (q.isActive('side_lilies') && q.stageIndex('side_lilies') === 1) return 'elna_lilies_complete';
685:       if (q.isCompleted('side_lilies')) return 'elna_default';
686:       return 'elna_intro';
687:     case 'tilo':
688:       if (q.isActive('side_echo') && q.stageIndex('side_echo') === 1) return 'tilo_echo_complete';
689:       if (q.isCompleted('side_echo')) return 'tilo_default';
690:       return 'tilo_intro';
691:     case 'roderic': return flags['gem1'] ? 'roderic_intro' : 'roderic_gate_locked';
692:     case 'kael':
693:       if (q.isActive('side_survivors') && q.stageIndex('side_survivors') === 1) return 'kael_survivors_complete';
694:       if (q.isActive('main_drakmor') && flags['dama-choice']) return 'kael_after_dama';
695:       if (!flags['kael_met']) return 'kael_intro';
696:       return 'kael_default';
697:     case 'nira':
698:       if (q.isActive('side_obsidian') && q.stageIndex('side_obsidian') === 1) return 'nira_golems_complete';
699:       return 'nira_intro';
700:     case 'survivor1': return 'survivor1';
701:     case 'survivor2': return 'survivor2';
702:     case 'survivor3': return 'survivor3';
703:     case 'survivor4': return 'survivor4';
704:     case 'aurel':
705:       if (q.isActive('side_balance') && q.stageIndex('side_balance') === 1) return 'aurel_balance';
706:       if (!flags['aurel_met']) return 'aurel_intro';
707:       return 'aurel_default';
708:     case 'vela':
709:       if (q.isActive('side_garden') && q.stageIndex('side_garden') === 1) return 'vela_garden';
710:       return 'vela_intro';
711:     case 'echo': return 'echo_final';
712:     default: return null;
713:   }
714: }

name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
    with:
      runtime_ref: 3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
    with:
      runtime_ref: 3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
      issue_number: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a real, playable Spanish-language fantasy action RPG called **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL** in the existing static web project, with Android/mobile support, aiming for exceptional quality (GOTY as aspiration, not a claim).
- The user’s prompt is in Spanish and was cut off mid-sentence; current scope includes character customization, three regions, story, combat, creatures, exploration, UI, audio, and polish.

## Requirements
- Name: **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL**; genre: action RPG, medieval fantasy, adventure, exploration, combat, creature collection.
- Android priority, horizontal orientation, Spanish from Spain, cinematic fantasy/anime aesthetic, original IP.
- Real playable game, not a mockup, design bible, or decorative demo.
- Regions: **VALDORIA**, **DRAKMOR**, **KANSORDORE**.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothing, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte with measurable effects; equipment affects stats and appearance; distinct animations.
- Story must be original, coherent, mysterious, with choices, consequences, memorable characters, and a satisfying ending.
- No false GOTY claims.
- Existing runtime serves a static `index.html` or Vite project; `capture.sh` auto-clicks a single visible button labeled `Start`/`Play` (English) then screenshots desktop 1440×900 and mobile 390×844 after 1s.
- Mobile browser support: responsive layouts, usable touch controls, safe areas, no browser gesture conflicts, iOS motion permission only from user gesture if tilt is used.

## Decisions
- Build a **2D top-down action RPG using Canvas 2D + DOM UI**, plain ES modules, no external runtime dependencies, served statically.
- Use procedural art and synthesized WebAudio music/SFX; downloaded local fonts (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`).
- Title screen will use a Spanish `JUGAR` button with `aria-label="Play"` so automated capture finds it.
- `JUGAR` opens the character creator (portrait-friendly), not directly gameplay; gameplay will show a rotate-device hint in portrait.
- Implement three regions, 12 collectible “Resonancias,” 11 normal enemy types, 3 bosses, 3 endings, 12 skill nodes, equipment, shops, forge, quests, codex, map, save slots, settings, accessibility, and PWA support.
- Story final choice: **Restaurar el Velo**, **Romper el Velo**, or **Convergencia Absoluta**.
- `main_awakening` starts automatically; main quests chain via `next`.
- Boss doors require puzzle flags (`val-puzzle`, `drak-runes`, `kan-library` + 3 pages).
- Plan to deliver as a mobile-friendly PWA/browser game; native APK packaging is not currently implemented and should be explained as a limitation if relevant.
- Art system split into `src/render/sprites/{common,terrain,props,characters,enemies,portraits}.js` to avoid oversized single files.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repository/runtime and verification behavior.
- Downloaded fonts to `assets/fonts/`.
- Wrote core modules: `utils.js`, `input.js`, `audio.js`, `save.js`, `camera.js`, `particles.js`.
- Wrote data modules: `items.js`, `creatures.js`, `enemies.js`, `skills.js`, `regions.js`, `quests.js`, `story.js`.
- Wrote `world.js` with procedural maps, collision, props, interactables, A* pathfinding, three regions, arenas.
- Wrote `inventory.js`, `quests.js`, `collection.js`, `player.js`, `combat.js`, `enemy.js`.
- Wrote `src/game/boss.js`: three multi-phase bosses with patterns, telegraphs, phases, status handling, defeat hook `game.onBossDefeated`.
- Wrote `src/game/companion.js`: follow/attack AI, 12 active abilities, passive hooks, temporary companions via `summonCompanions`.
- Wrote `src/render/sprites/common.js`: shared drawing helpers (`shadow`, `glowCircle`, `line`, `star`, `roundRect`, `eye`, `flame`, `crystalShape`, `humanHair`).
- Wrote `src/render/sprites/terrain.js`: procedural tile rendering for all 16 tile types across three region palettes.
- Wrote `src/render/sprites/props.js`: trees, rocks, houses, ruins, shrines, seals, chests, braziers, levers, crystals, gates, forge, signs, and other interactables.
- Wrote `src/render/sprites/characters.js`: animated humanoid renderer, player equipment/appearance rendering, NPC renderer.
- Wrote `src/render/sprites/enemies.js`: all normal enemies, three boss sprites, creature/companion sprites.
- Wrote `src/render/sprites/portraits.js`: dialogue portraits including special cases for Velo, Jarra, Guardián, Aurel, and player.

### Active
- Building the game implementation. Next major missing pieces: sprite barrel export, renderer, UI/screens, main game bootstrap, `index.html`, CSS, PWA assets, dialogue runner, save/load integration, testing.
- All current files passed `node --check` before the latest new files; recheck all `src/**/*.js`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check` on all `src/**/*.js`; fix syntax/runtime issues, especially new render modules.
2. Create `src/render/sprites.js` barrel export for the split sprite modules.
3. Implement `src/render/renderer.js`: terrain cache, depth-sorted props/entities, lighting overlay, weather, minimap, title/creator backdrop, boss/HUD drawing support.
4. Implement `src/ui/ui.js` + screens: title, character creator, HUD, dialogue, pause/menu, inventory, skills, codex, journal, map, settings, shop, forge, save/load, death, endings.
5. Implement `src/main.js` game class: world loading, region transitions, spawning, combat loop, interactions, quests, dialogue actions, boss triggers, rewards, autosave, endings.
6. Write `index.html`, `styles.css`, PWA `manifest.webmanifest`, service worker, icons.
7. Test locally with `playwright-cli`/`capture.sh`; inspect desktop/mobile screenshots and fix visual/functional issues.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: missing; UI/visual styling and responsive/touch layout.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/render/sprites/`: split procedural art modules; needs barrel export.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game/world.js`: procedural world, collision, A*.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/quests.js`: main/side quest definitions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/skills.js`: origins, skill trees, difficulties, weapon types.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/core/audio.js`: procedural music/SFX.

## Important Context
- Runtime entrypoint: static `index.html` or Vite; no package.json currently.
- `capture-start.mjs` clicks only a visible, enabled button whose aria-label/text matches `Start`, `Play`, `Start game`, `Play game`, `Start now`, or `Play now`; avoid multiple matching buttons.
- Mobile capture is portrait 390×844; character creator should look good in portrait.

- `story.js` references `game.quests.stageIndex(...)`, `game.inventory.count(...)`, `game.player.flags`; those APIs are implemented.
- `player.js` depends on `game.inventory`, `game.collection`, `game.settings`, `game.ui`, `game.particles`, `game.audio`, `game.camera`, `game.world`, `game.enemies`, `game.nearestEnemy`, `game.spawnProjectile`, `game.summonAllCompanions`.
- `enemy.js` calls `game.onEnemyKilled`, `game.spawnProjectile`, `game.difficulty`.
- `boss.js` calls `game.onBossDefeated`, `game.spawnZone`, `game.spawnEnemy`, `game.spawnProjectile`, `game.difficulty`, `game.ui.toast`.
- `companion.js` calls `game.nearestEnemy`, `game.spawnProjectile`, `game.spawnZone`, `game.revealSecrets`, `game.collection`, `game.companions`.
- `world.js` has a known minor issue: `_buildSpecialProps` places a `forgeBig` solid prop near the Drakmor arena; verify it does not block the boss arena.
- `regions.js` Kansordore enemy zone at `{x:36,y:30}` and other placements should be visually checked for reachability.
- `quests.js` `side_survivors` uses four separate flag objectives; `side_hammer` requires `orin_hammer`, added to `val-chest-4`.
- `story.js` has some long dialogue and likely needs condition/branch verification; `getNpcScript` depends on `game.quests.stageIndex`.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

663: export function getNpcScript(npcId, game) {
664:   const q = game.quests;
665:   const flags = game.player.flags;
666:   const has = (id, qty = 1) => game.inventory.count(id) >= qty;
667:   switch (npcId) {
668:     case 'maren':
669:       if (q.isActive('main_roots')) return flags['val-puzzle'] ? 'maren_default' : 'maren_hint_ruins';
670:       if (q.isCompleted('main_roots')) return flags['maren_truth'] ? 'maren_default' : 'maren_after_guardian';
671:       if (q.isActive('main_shrine')) return 'maren_shrine_hint';
672:       if (!q.isCompleted('main_awakening')) return 'maren_intro';
673:       return 'maren_default';
674:     case 'lyra':
675:       if (q.isActive('main_shrine') && flags['shrine_done']) return 'lyra_shrine';
676:       if (q.isActive('main_roots') && !flags['val-puzzle']) return 'lyra_ruins';
677:       return 'lyra_default';
678:     case 'orin':
679:       if (q.isActive('side_hammer') && has('orin_hammer')) return 'orin_return_hammer';
680:       if (!q.isCompleted('side_hammer') && !q.isActive('side_hammer')) return 'orin_intro';
681:       return 'orin_default';
682:     case 'sela': return q.isCompleted('main_awakening') ? 'sela_default' : 'sela_intro';
683:     case 'elna':
684:       if (q.isActive('side_lilies') && q.stageIndex('side_lilies') === 1) return 'elna_lilies_complete';
685:       if (q.isCompleted('side_lilies')) return 'elna_default';
686:       return 'elna_intro';
687:     case 'tilo':
688:       if (q.isActive('side_echo') && q.stageIndex('side_echo') === 1) return 'tilo_echo_complete';
689:       if (q.isCompleted('side_echo')) return 'tilo_default';
690:       return 'tilo_intro';
691:     case 'roderic': return flags['gem1'] ? 'roderic_intro' : 'roderic_gate_locked';
692:     case 'kael':
693:       if (q.isActive('side_survivors') && q.stageIndex('side_survivors') === 1) return 'kael_survivors_complete';
694:       if (q.isActive('main_drakmor') && flags['dama-choice']) return 'kael_after_dama';
695:       if (!flags['kael_met']) return 'kael_intro';
696:       return 'kael_default';
697:     case 'nira':
698:       if (q.isActive('side_obsidian') && q.stageIndex('side_obsidian') === 1) return 'nira_golems_complete';
699:       return 'nira_intro';
700:     case 'survivor1': return 'survivor1';
701:     case 'survivor2': return 'survivor2';
702:     case 'survivor3': return 'survivor3';
703:     case 'survivor4': return 'survivor4';
704:     case 'aurel':
705:       if (q.isActive('side_balance') && q.stageIndex('side_balance') === 1) return 'aurel_balance';
706:       if (!flags['aurel_met']) return 'aurel_intro';
707:       return 'aurel_default';
708:     case 'vela':

710:       return 'vela_intro';

712:     default: return null;

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a real, playable Spanish-language fantasy action RPG called **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL** in the existing static web project, with Android/mobile support, aiming for exceptional quality (GOTY as aspiration, not a claim).
- The user’s prompt is in Spanish and was cut off mid-sentence; current scope includes character customization, three regions, story, combat, creatures, exploration, UI, audio, and polish.

## Requirements
- Name: **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL**; genre: action RPG, medieval fantasy, adventure, exploration, combat, creature collection.
- Android priority, horizontal orientation, Spanish from Spain, cinematic fantasy/anime aesthetic, original IP.
- Real playable game, not a mockup, design bible, or decorative demo.
- Regions: **VALDORIA**, **DRAKMOR**, **KANSORDORE**.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothing, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte with measurable effects; equipment affects stats and appearance; distinct animations.
- Story must be original, coherent, mysterious, with choices, consequences, memorable characters, and a satisfying ending.
- No false GOTY claims.
- Existing runtime serves a static `index.html` or Vite project; `capture.sh` auto-clicks a single visible button labeled `Start`/`Play` (English) then screenshots desktop 1440×900 and mobile 390×844 after 1s.
- Mobile browser support: responsive layouts, usable touch controls, safe areas, no browser gesture conflicts, iOS motion permission only from user gesture if tilt is used.

## Decisions
- Build a **2D top-down action RPG using Canvas 2D + DOM UI**, plain ES modules, no external runtime dependencies, served statically.
- Use procedural art and synthesized WebAudio music/SFX; downloaded local fonts (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`).
- Title screen uses a Spanish `JUGAR` button with `aria-label="Play"` so automated capture finds it; title also offers `CREAR PERSONAJE`, `CONTINUAR`, and `AJUSTES`.
- **Changed from prior plan:** `JUGAR` now starts gameplay directly with a default character so automated capture sees actual gameplay; character creator remains accessible via the prominent `CREAR PERSONAJE` button.
- Gameplay shows a rotate-device hint in portrait; creator remains usable in portrait.
- Implement three regions, 12 collectible “Resonancias,” 11 normal enemy types, 3 bosses, 3 endings, 12 skill nodes, equipment, shops, forge, quests, codex, map, save slots, settings, accessibility, and PWA support.
- Story final choice: **Restaurar el Velo**, **Romper el Velo**, or **Convergencia Absoluta**.

663: export function getNpcScript(npcId, game) {
664:   const q = game.quests;
665:   const flags = game.player.flags;
666:   const has = (id, qty = 1) => game.inventory.count(id) >= qty;
667:   switch (npcId) {
668:     case 'maren':
669:       if (q.isActive('main_roots')) return flags['val-puzzle'] ? 'maren_default' : 'maren_hint_ruins';
670:       if (q.isCompleted('main_roots')) return flags['maren_truth'] ? 'maren_default' : 'maren_after_guardian';
671:       if (q.isActive('main_shrine')) return 'maren_shrine_hint';
672:       if (!q.isCompleted('main_awakening')) return 'maren_intro';
673:       return 'maren_default';
674:     case 'lyra':
675:       if (q.isActive('main_shrine') && flags['shrine_done']) return 'lyra_shrine';
676:       if (q.isActive('main_roots') && !flags['val-puzzle']) return 'lyra_ruins';
677:       return 'lyra_default';
678:     case 'orin':
679:       if (q.isActive('side_hammer') && has('orin_hammer')) return 'orin_return_hammer';
680:       if (!q.isCompleted('side_hammer') && !q.isActive('side_hammer')) return 'orin_intro';
681:       return 'orin_default';
682:     case 'sela': return q.isCompleted('main_awakening') ? 'sela_default' : 'sela_intro';
683:     case 'elna':
684:       if (q.isActive('side_lilies') && q.stageIndex('side_lilies') === 1) return 'elna_lilies_complete';
685:       if (q.isCompleted('side_lilies')) return 'elna_default';
686:       return 'elna_intro';
687:     case 'tilo':
688:       if (q.isActive('side_echo') && q.stageIndex('side_echo') === 1) return 'tilo_echo_complete';
689:       if (q.isCompleted('side_echo')) return 'tilo_default';
690:       return 'tilo_intro';
691:     case 'roderic': return flags['gem1'] ? 'roderic_intro' : 'roderic_gate_locked';
692:     case 'kael':
693:       if (q.isActive('side_survivors') && q.stageIndex('side_survivors') === 1) return 'kael_survivors_complete';
694:       if (q.isActive('main_drakmor') && flags['dama-choice']) return 'kael_after_dama';
695:       if (!flags['kael_met']) return 'kael_intro';
696:       return 'kael_default';
697:     case 'nira':
698:       if (q.isActive('side_obsidian') && q.stageIndex('side_obsidian') === 1) return 'nira_golems_complete';
699:       return 'nira_intro';
700:     case 'survivor1': return 'survivor1';
701:     case 'survivor2': return 'survivor2';
702:     case 'survivor3': return 'survivor3';
703:     case 'survivor4': return 'survivor4';
704:     case 'aurel':
705:       if (q.isActive('side_balance') && q.stageIndex('side_balance') === 1) return 'aurel_balance';
706:       if (!flags['aurel_met']) return 'aurel_intro';
707:       return 'aurel_default';
708:     case 'vela':
709:       if (q.isActive('side_garden') && q.stageIndex('side_garden') === 1) return 'vela_garden';
710:       return 'vela_intro';
711:     case 'echo': return 'echo_final';
712:     default: return null;

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a real, playable Spanish-language fantasy action RPG called **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL** in the existing static web project, with Android/mobile support, aiming for exceptional quality (GOTY as aspiration, not a claim).
- The user’s prompt is in Spanish and was cut off mid-sentence; current scope includes character customization, three regions, story, combat, creatures, exploration, UI, audio, and polish.

## Requirements
- Name: **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL**; genre: action RPG, medieval fantasy, adventure, exploration, combat, creature collection.
- Android priority, horizontal orientation, Spanish from Spain, cinematic fantasy/anime aesthetic, original IP.
- Real playable game, not a mockup, design bible, or decorative demo.
- Regions: **VALDORIA**, **DRAKMOR**, **KANSORDORE**.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothing, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte with measurable effects; equipment affects stats and appearance; distinct animations.
- Story must be original, coherent, mysterious, with choices, consequences, memorable characters, and a satisfying ending.
- No false GOTY claims.
- Existing runtime serves a static `index.html` or Vite project; `capture.sh` auto-clicks a single visible button labeled `Start`/`Play` (English) then screenshots desktop 1440×900 and mobile 390×844 after 1s.
- Mobile browser support: responsive layouts, usable touch controls, safe areas, no browser gesture conflicts, iOS motion permission only from user gesture if tilt is used.

## Decisions
- Build a **2D top-down action RPG using Canvas 2D + DOM UI**, plain ES modules, no external runtime dependencies, served statically.
- Use procedural art and synthesized WebAudio music/SFX; downloaded local fonts (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`).
- Title screen uses a Spanish `JUGAR` button with `aria-label="Play"` so automated capture finds it; title also offers `CREAR PERSONAJE`, `CONTINUAR`, and `AJUSTES`.
- `JUGAR` starts gameplay directly with a default character so automated capture sees actual gameplay; character creator remains accessible via the prominent `CREAR PERSONAJE` button.
- Gameplay shows a rotate-device hint in portrait after ~1.8s delay (so capture at ~1s still shows gameplay); creator remains usable in portrait.
- Implement three regions, 12 collectible “Resonancias,” 11 normal enemy types, 3 bosses, 3 endings, 12 skill nodes, equipment, shops, forge, quests, codex, map, save slots, settings, accessibility, and PWA support.
- Story final choice: **Restaurar el Velo**, **Romper el Velo**, or **Convergencia Absoluta**.
- `main_awakening` starts automatically; main quests chain via `next`.
- Boss doors require puzzle flags (`val-puzzle`, `drak-runes`, `kan-library` + 3 pages).
- Plan to deliver as a mobile-friendly PWA/browser game; native APK packaging is not currently implemented and should be explained as a limitation if relevant.
- Art system split into `src/render/sprites/{common,terrain,props,characters,enemies,portraits}.js`; barrel export added at `src/render/sprites.js`.
- UI is DOM-driven, built dynamically by `src/ui/ui.js`; title/creator/HUD/dialogue markup and screens are in `index.html`; visual system in `styles.css`.
- New `src/ui/ui.js` implements title/creator binding, character creator state/preview, HUD sync, dialogue typewriter/choices, pause menu, inventory/stats/resonance panels, skills, journal, codex, map, settings, shop, forge, save/load, help, lore, death/ending screens, toasts, and orientation handling.
- UI expects game methods/properties: `game.quickStart()`, `startNewGame(config)`, `continueGame()`, `latestSaveInfo()`, `getAutoSave()`, `saveSlot(slot)`, `loadSlot(slot)`, `returnToTitle()`, `revive()`, `showEnding(id)`, `applySettings()`, `autosave()`, `pendingEnding`, `bestiary`, `lore`, `activeBoss`, `nearTarget`, `time`, `paused`, `dialogueActive`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repository/runtime and verification behavior.
- Downloaded fonts to `assets/fonts/`: `cinzel.woff2`, `cormorant.woff2`, `cormorant-italic.woff2`.

- Wrote data modules: `items.js`, `creatures.js`, `enemies.js`, `skills.js`, `regions.js`, `quests.js`, `story.js`.
- Wrote `world.js` with procedural maps, collision, props, interactables, A* pathfinding, three regions, arenas.
- Wrote `inventory.js`, `quests.js`, `collection.js`, `player.js`, `combat.js`, `enemy.js`.
- Wrote `src/game/boss.js`: three multi-phase bosses with patterns, telegraphs, phases, status handling, defeat hook `game.onBossDefeated`.
- Wrote `src/game/companion.js`: follow/attack AI, 12 active abilities, passive hooks, temporary companions via `summonCompanions`.
- Wrote all procedural sprite modules: common, terrain, props, characters, enemies, portraits.

- Created `src/render/renderer.js` with terrain/minimap caching, depth-sorted world rendering, lighting/vignette/weather, title backdrop, creator preview, portrait rendering, minimap, boss/enemy/companion drawing.
- Created `index.html` with title, creator, HUD, dialogue, pause, dynamic panel, death, ending, touch controls, rotate hint, toasts, loading/fatal overlays.
- Created `styles.css` with full fantasy visual system, responsive desktop/mobile layouts, safe-area support, touch controls, animations, and all panel/screen styling.

663: export function getNpcScript(npcId, game) {
664:   const q = game.quests;
665:   const flags = game.player.flags;
666:   const has = (id, qty = 1) => game.inventory.count(id) >= qty;
667:   switch (npcId) {
668:     case 'maren':
669:       if (q.isActive('main_roots')) return flags['val-puzzle'] ? 'maren_default' : 'maren_hint_ruins';
670:       if (q.isCompleted('main_roots')) return flags['maren_truth'] ? 'maren_default' : 'maren_after_guardian';
671:       if (q.isActive('main_shrine')) return 'maren_shrine_hint';
672:       if (!q.isCompleted('main_awakening')) return 'maren_intro';
673:       return 'maren_default';
674:     case 'lyra':
675:       if (q.isActive('main_shrine') && flags['shrine_done']) return 'lyra_shrine';
676:       if (q.isActive('main_roots') && !flags['val-puzzle']) return 'lyra_ruins';
677:       return 'lyra_default';
678:     case 'orin':
679:       if (q.isActive('side_hammer') && has('orin_hammer')) return 'orin_return_hammer';
680:       if (!q.isCompleted('side_hammer') && !q.isActive('side_hammer')) return 'orin_intro';
681:       return 'orin_default';
682:     case 'sela': return q.isCompleted('main_awakening') ? 'sela_default' : 'sela_intro';
683:     case 'elna':
684:       if (q.isActive('side_lilies') && q.stageIndex('side_lilies') === 1) return 'elna_lilies_complete';
685:       if (q.isCompleted('side_lilies')) return 'elna_default';
686:       return 'elna_intro';
687:     case 'tilo':
688:       if (q.isActive('side_echo') && q.stageIndex('side_echo') === 1) return 'tilo_echo_complete';
689:       if (q.isCompleted('side_echo')) return 'tilo_default';
690:       return 'tilo_intro';
691:     case 'roderic': return flags['gem1'] ? 'roderic_intro' : 'roderic_gate_locked';
692:     case 'kael':
693:       if (q.isActive('side_survivors') && q.stageIndex('side_survivors') === 1) return 'kael_survivors_complete';
694:       if (q.isActive('main_drakmor') && flags['dama-choice']) return 'kael_after_dama';
695:       if (!flags['kael_met']) return 'kael_intro';
696:       return 'kael_default';
697:     case 'nira':
698:       if (q.isActive('side_obsidian') && q.stageIndex('side_obsidian') === 1) return 'nira_golems_complete';
699:       return 'nira_intro';
700:     case 'survivor1': return 'survivor1';
701:     case 'survivor2': return 'survivor2';
702:     case 'survivor3': return 'survivor3';
703:     case 'survivor4': return 'survivor4';
704:     case 'aurel':
705:       if (q.isActive('side_balance') && q.stageIndex('side_balance') === 1) return 'aurel_balance';
706:       if (!flags['aurel_met']) return 'aurel_intro';
707:       return 'aurel_default';
708:     case 'vela':
709:       if (q.isActive('side_garden') && q.stageIndex('side_garden') === 1) return 'vela_garden';
710:       return 'vela_intro';
711:     case 'echo': return 'echo_final';
712:     default: return null;
713:   }
714: }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
---
name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
    with:
      runtime_ref: 3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
    with:
      runtime_ref: 3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
      issue_number: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
---

import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs'
import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

Main task now. Need robust integration. Let's plan main.js carefully.

Core Game fields expected:
- state: 'title' initially
- settings from SaveSystem
- saveSystem
- audio
- input
- renderer
- camera
- particles
- world, regionId, npcs, enemies, bosses, companions, projectiles, zones, flags
- quests, inventory, collection
- player
- time, fps, paused, dialogueActive, hitstop, inCombat, autoAim, difficulty, activeBoss, nearTarget, nearNpc
- events emitter
- bestiary, lore

UI created after game fields initialized, but UI constructor calls showTitle -> game.latestSaveInfo and audio.setTrack('title'). Need renderer/audio available. Sequence:
1. instantiate SaveSystem, AudioEngine, Particles, Camera, Input(canvas), Renderer(canvas, game)
2. settings, difficulty, flags, quests? UI constructor uses game.settings.difficulty, latestSaveInfo. Create UI after saveSystem etc. It also calls game.audio.sfx on interactions only.
3. UI -> title.
4. resize handler, bindTouch, start loop.
5. try load manifest etc.

Need event emitter minimal.

Game methods:
- quickStart(): default new game with config default, no creator; startNewGame({name:'Peregrino', origin:'brasa', ...}) maybe mark quick. Should immediately show gameplay. Capture click then 1s screenshot: title click -> new game -> intro dialogue? The capture after 1s should show actual gameplay. If prologue dialogue opens immediately, that's still game content (dialogue overlay) but the plan said gameplay directly. "JUGAR starts gameplay directly with default character so automated capture sees actual gameplay; character creator remains accessible." Likely open prologue dialogue? The checkpoint says gameplay shows; maybe prologue could open after short delay. Better: quickStart starts world and shows region banner and maybe toast, not dialogue; player can move. Maybe begin main quest. Could open prologue after ~1.2s but screenshot at 1s sees gameplay. But capture desktop and mobile sequential; mobile after desktop in separate page. Could be okay. I'd rather start prologue immediately? No. Start gameplay, with a toast "La octava vida" and maybe open prologue after 2.5s. But automation waits 1s; should see gameplay HUD. Good.

- startNewGame(config): reset state, create player. Need apply origin and baseStats/config. Player.initNew then set name, origin, appearance, baseStats from config, bonusCrit, difficulty setting. Note creator baseStats already includes origin bonuses. Player.applyOrigin would add origin bonus again; instead set origin and baseStats manually. But player.recalc uses stats. We'll set player.origin, player.baseStats = {...config.baseStats}, player.bonusCrit, appearance, name. Difficulty set game.settings.difficulty = config.difficulty and game.difficulty = DIFFICULTIES[...]. Save settings. Then initialize world etc. Give default equipment. Add maybe starting items. Start quest main_awakening. Start at spawn. Show HUD. Show region banner. Start music. Maybe open prologue after 2s only if not quick? Hmm quickStart should have same new game. Maybe both start with prologue after 0.8 sec. But capture at 1s might catch dialogue. The UI shows dialogue over gameplay which is fine. Yet "sees actual gameplay" suggests avoid full-screen title. Dialogue is still actual game. But to be safe, delay prologue 2.2s for quickStart, and for regular new game too. The user sees intro shortly. Good.

- continueGame(): load latest save, either auto or slot. latestSaveInfo returns record meta plus source. Use latest of manual slots and autosave. continueGame uses loadData(data, source) with savedAt. If none, quickStart.

- latestSaveInfo(): compare auto savedAt and latest manual slot; return record.

- getAutoSave(): record from localStorage. We'll implement local read/write key.

- saveSlot(slot): serialize, saveSystem.save. maybe update UI.
- loadSlot(slot): data = saveSystem.load; loadGame(data); return true.
- returnToTitle(): reset paused, ui.showTitle, state title, audio title, input enabled, maybe clear entities/world? keep world? renderer draws title for title state. Clear dialogue if open. Must call ui showTitle. Set player? Keep for codex? Not needed. Maybe null player. UI refreshTitle uses latestSaveInfo.
- revive(): player.reviveAt last waypoint or region spawn; hideDeath; state playing; paused false; input enabled; clear enemies near? Restore boss? If died in boss fight, boss should reset. We'll handle onPlayerDeath: state 'dead'? renderer draws world for any non-title. UI showDeath. If boss active, reset boss (remove from bosses and clear boss flag? Door remains unlocked; can re-enter). We'll store lastSafe. For revive: if in boss arena, respawn at last waypoint and reset boss. Simpler: reset region (recreate world & entities) at last waypoint, flags preserved. But that could lose world state. Alternative remove boss & activeBoss, teleport to last waypoint, restore HP, and respawn region enemies? We can respawn boss when door triggered again. Good.
- showEnding(id): ui.showEnding(id), state 'ending', paused true, input disabled, audio.setTrack('ending'), set flag ending-choice, complete main_veil? Need set flags and quest. ui.showEnding uses player stats. Save? maybe auto.
- applySettings(): audio volumes, body classes large-text? CSS has no .large-text rules maybe add. Set touchOpacity CSS var; renderer maybe showFps. `this.settings` same object. Save settings.

- spawnProjectile(opts), spawnZone(opts), spawnEnemy(typeId,x,y,opts), nearestEnemy(x,y,range,opts), revealSecrets(), summonAllCompanions(), useCompanion(), escapeCombat(), interact(), onEnemyKilled(enemy), onBossDefeated(boss), onPlayerDeath(), giveRewards(rewards), setFlag(name,value), canCapture(enemy), tryCapture(), interactableState(it), canInteract.

## Objective
- Build a real, playable Spanish-language fantasy action RPG called **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL** in the existing static web project, with Android/mobile support, aiming for exceptional quality (GOTY as aspiration, not a claim).
- The user’s prompt is in Spanish and was cut off mid-sentence; current scope includes character customization, three regions, story, combat, creatures, exploration, UI, audio, and polish.

## Requirements
- Name: **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL**; genre: action RPG, medieval fantasy, adventure, exploration, combat, creature collection.
- Android priority, horizontal orientation, Spanish from Spain, cinematic fantasy/anime aesthetic, original IP.
- Real playable game, not a mockup, design bible, or decorative demo.
- Regions: **VALDORIA**, **DRAKMOR**, **KANSORDORE**.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothing, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte with measurable effects; equipment affects stats and appearance; distinct animations.
- Story must be original, coherent, mysterious, with choices, consequences, memorable characters, and a satisfying ending.
- No false GOTY claims.
- Existing runtime serves a static `index.html` or Vite project; `capture.sh` auto-clicks a single visible button labeled `Start`/`Play` (English) then screenshots desktop 1440×900 and mobile 390×844 after 1s.
- Mobile browser support: responsive layouts, usable touch controls, safe areas, no browser gesture conflicts, iOS motion permission only from user gesture if tilt is used.

## Decisions
- Build a **2D top-down action RPG using Canvas 2D + DOM UI**, plain ES modules, no external runtime dependencies, served statically.
- Use procedural art and synthesized WebAudio music/SFX; downloaded local fonts (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`).
- Title screen uses a Spanish `JUGAR` button with `aria-label="Play"` so automated capture finds it; title also offers `CREAR PERSONAJE`, `CONTINUAR`, and `AJUSTES`.
- `JUGAR` starts gameplay directly with a default character so automated capture sees actual gameplay; character creator remains accessible via the prominent `CREAR PERSONAJE` button.
- Gameplay shows a rotate-device hint in portrait after ~1.8s delay (so capture at ~1s still shows gameplay); creator remains usable in portrait.
- Implement three regions, 12 collectible “Resonancias,” 11 normal enemy types, 3 bosses, 3 endings, 12 skill nodes, equipment, shops, forge, quests, codex, map, save slots, settings, accessibility, and PWA support.
- Story final choice: **Restaurar el Velo**, **Romper el Velo**, or **Convergencia Absoluta**.
- `main_awakening` starts automatically; main quests chain via `next`.
- Boss doors require puzzle flags (`val-puzzle`, `drak-runes`, `kan-library` + 3 pages).
- Plan to deliver as a mobile-friendly PWA/browser game; native APK packaging is not currently implemented and should be explained as a limitation if relevant.
- Art system split into `src/render/sprites/{common,terrain,props,characters,enemies,portraits}.js`; barrel export added at `src/render/sprites.js`.
- UI is DOM-driven, built dynamically by `src/ui/ui.js`; title/creator/HUD/dialogue markup and screens are in `index.html`; visual system in `styles.css`.
- New `src/ui/ui.js` implements title/creator binding, character creator state/preview, HUD sync, dialogue typewriter/choices, pause menu, inventory/stats/resonance panels, skills, journal, codex, map, settings, shop, forge, save/load, help, lore, death/ending screens, toasts, and orientation handling.
- UI expects game methods/properties: `game.quickStart()`, `startNewGame(config)`, `continueGame()`, `latestSaveInfo()`, `getAutoSave()`, `saveSlot(slot)`, `loadSlot(slot)`, `returnToTitle()`, `revive()`, `showEnding(id)`, `applySettings()`, `autosave()`, `pendingEnding`, `bestiary`, `lore`, `activeBoss`, `nearTarget`, `time`, `paused`, `dialogueActive`.
- `index.html` uses `src/main.js` as the module entrypoint; no `package.json` exists, so the runtime treats this as a static HTML project.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repository/runtime and verification behavior.
- Downloaded fonts to `assets/fonts/`: `cinzel.woff2`, `cormorant.woff2`, `cormorant-italic.woff2`.
- Wrote core modules: `utils.js`, `input.js`, `audio.js`, `save.js`, `camera.js`, `particles.js`.
- Wrote data modules: `items.js`, `creatures.js`, `enemies.js`, `skills.js`, `regions.js`, `quests.js`, `story.js`.
- Wrote `world.js` with procedural maps, collision, props, interactables, A* pathfinding, three regions, arenas.
- Wrote `inventory.js`, `quests.js`, `collection.js`, `player.js`, `combat.js`, `enemy.js`.
- Wrote `src/game/boss.js`: three multi-phase bosses with patterns, telegraphs, phases, status handling, defeat hook `game.onBossDefeated`.
- Wrote `src/game/companion.js`: follow/attack AI, 12 active abilities, passive hooks, temporary companions via `summonCompanions`.
- Wrote all procedural sprite modules: common, terrain, props, characters, enemies, portraits.
- Created `src/render/sprites.js` barrel export.
- Created `src/render/renderer.js` with terrain/minimap caching, depth-sorted world rendering, lighting/vignette/weather, title backdrop, creator preview, portrait rendering, minimap, boss/enemy/companion drawing.
- Created `index.html` with title, creator, HUD, dialogue, pause, dynamic panel, death, ending, touch controls, rotate hint, toasts, loading/fatal overlays.
- Created `styles.css` with full fantasy visual system, responsive desktop/mobile layouts, safe-area support, touch controls, animations, and all panel/screen styling.
- Created `src/ui/ui.js` with the full DOM/UI layer.
- Ran `node --check` on all `src/**/*.js`, including `src/ui/ui.js`; no syntax errors.

### Active
- Building remaining integration: `src/main.js`, PWA assets, save/load wiring, and end-to-end testing.
- `index.html` references missing `manifest.webmanifest`, `assets/icons/icon.svg`, `assets/icons/icon-192.png`, and `src/main.js`; these must be created.
- `src/ui/ui.js` has not yet been runtime-tested.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/main.js` Game class: bootstrap, title/creator/game states, new game/load, world/region transitions, entity spawning, combat loop, interactions, dialogue action execution, quests, boss triggers/rewards, autosave, endings, error handling.
2. Add `KeyV: 'capture'` to `src/core/input.js`; wire main loop to call `tryCapture()` on `input.justPressed('capture')`.
3. Add missing UI methods `setActiveCreature(id)` and `feedCreature(id)` used by `ui.js` panel actions.
4. Add PWA assets: `manifest.webmanifest`, service worker, icons (`icon.svg`, `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png`); register service worker in `main.js`.
5. Fix known integration/data issues: duplicate rewards/loot (`gem_shard` guardian boss loot vs `guardian_defeat`; `first_tear` dama boss loot vs dialogue; duplicate `pilgrim_blade` in `side_hammer` rewards vs `orin_return_hammer`); `side_garden` not started by `vela_intro`; `vela_intro` repeats after completion; `nira_intro` repeats after `side_obsidian`; `world.ambient` never assigned (`_ambient` bug); move `forgeBig` away from Drakmor boss door/arena.
6. Verify reachability/placement issues: Drakmor `forgeBig` near bossdoor/arena, Kansordore enemy zone at `{x:36,y:30}`, puzzle/gate/bossdoor interactions, and all region spawn points.
7. Test locally with a static server and `playwright-cli`/`capture.sh`; inspect desktop 1440×900 and mobile 390×844 screenshots and fix visual/functional issues.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: missing; central game bootstrap/loop and all integration logic.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui/ui.js`: full UI layer; needs runtime verification and two missing creature methods.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: complete DOM shell referencing missing PWA assets and `src/main.js`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: complete responsive visual system; no `.large-text` or `touchOpacity` CSS rules yet.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/render/renderer.js`: expects `game.state`, `regionId`, `world`, `camera`, `zones`, `flags`, `npcs`, `enemies`, `bosses`, `companions`, `player`, `projectiles`, `particles`, `settings.showFps`, `fps`, `interactableState(it)`, `canCapture(enemy)`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game/player.js`: player stats/combat/spells/serialization; depends on many game methods.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game/world.js`: procedural world/collision/A*; `TILE` export; `ambient` bug.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game/boss.js`: boss phases/patterns and `game.onBossDefeated` hook.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game/companion.js`: companion AI and active abilities.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/story.js`: dialogue scripts, NPC script selection, endings, actions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/regions.js`: region content, interactables, enemy zones, boss arenas.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/quests.js`: main/side quest stages and rewards.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/core/input.js`: needs `KeyV: 'capture'`; touch binding API.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/core/save.js`: save slots/settings; main should add separate autosave storage.

## Important Context
- Runtime entrypoint: static `index.html`; no `package.json` currently.
- `capture-start.mjs` clicks only a visible, enabled button whose aria-label/text matches `Start`, `Play`, `Start game`, `Play game`, `Start now`, or `Play now`; `JUGAR` has `aria-label="Play"` and must remain the only matching button.
- Mobile capture is portrait 390×844; ensure title/creator/HUD remain usable and attractive in portrait.
- `start.sh` runs `default-start.mjs`; `capture.sh` runs `default-capture.mjs`.
- `story.js` references `game.quests.stageIndex(...)`, `game.inventory.count(...)`, `game.player.flags`; `player.flags` delegates to `game.flags`.
- `player.js` depends on `game.inventory`, `game.collection`, `game.settings`, `game.ui`, `game.particles`, `game.audio`, `game.camera`, `game.world`, `game.enemies`, `game.nearestEnemy`, `game.spawnProjectile`, `game.summonAllCompanions`.
- `enemy.js` calls `game.onEnemyKilled`, `game.spawnProjectile`, `game.difficulty`.
- `boss.js` calls `game.onBossDefeated`, `game.spawnZone`, `game.spawnEnemy`, `game.spawnProjectile`, `game.difficulty`, `game.ui.toast`.
- `companion.js` calls `game.nearestEnemy`, `game.spawnProjectile`, `game.spawnZone`, `game.revealSecrets`, `game.collection`, `game.companions`.
- `world.npcs` includes `survivor1..4` while matching `survivor` interactables also exist; renderer skips interactable type `survivor`.
- `story.js` `getNpcScript` can return `aurel_balance`; `SCRIPTS.aurel_balance` is defined after the function.
- Capture mechanic planned on key `V` / touch button `data-action="capture"`: weaken a capturable enemy, then use `collection.captureChance`.
- `renderer.js` draws title for states `title` and `creator`; all other states call `drawWorld`, so `main.js` must ensure `world` exists or use `title` until gameplay starts.
- `renderer.drawMinimap` and `drawPortrait`/`drawCreatorPreview` accept DOM canvases; UI calls them via `game.renderer`.
- No changes have been committed; all files remain untracked in the working tree.
- SaveSystem has 3 manual slots; main should use a separate autosave key (e.g. `la-espada-celestial.auto.v1`) and expose `getAutoSave()`/`latestSaveInfo()` for UI.
- Dialogue `onScriptEnd` must apply `script.onEnd`; `onClosed` handles pending panels (`shop`, `forge`), pending ambush, pending ending, and talk quest events.
- UI `openPanel` types: `inventory`, `skills`, `journal`, `codex`, `map`, `settings`, `shop`, `forge`, `save`, `help`, `lore`.
- UI `panelShop` expects `game.inventory.buyPrice/sellPrice`, `SHOPS` from `inventory.js`; forge expects `inventory.upgradeCost/applyUpgrade/has/remove`.
- UI `panelCodex` uses `game.bestiary` and `game.lore`; main must populate them.
- UI `showEnding` uses `ENDINGS`, player stats, collection count, kills, captures, playtime.

663: export function getNpcScript(npcId, game) {
664:   const q = game.quests;
665:   const flags = game.player.flags;
666:   const has = (id, qty = 1) => game.inventory.count(id) >= qty;
667:   switch (npcId) {
668:     case 'maren':
669:       if (q.isActive('main_roots')) return flags['val-puzzle'] ? 'maren_default' : 'maren_hint_ruins';
670:       if (q.isCompleted('main_roots')) return flags['maren_truth'] ? 'maren_default' : 'maren_after_guardian';
671:       if (q.isActive('main_shrine')) return 'maren_shrine_hint';
672:       if (!q.isCompleted('main_awakening')) return 'maren_intro';
673:       return 'maren_default';
674:     case 'lyra':
675:       if (q.isActive('main_shrine') && flags['shrine_done']) return 'lyra_shrine';
676:       if (q.isActive('main_roots') && !flags['val-puzzle']) return 'lyra_ruins';
677:       return 'lyra_default';
678:     case 'orin':
679:       if (q.isActive('side_hammer') && has('orin_hammer')) return 'orin_return_hammer';
680:       if (!q.isCompleted('side_hammer') && !q.isActive('side_hammer')) return 'orin_intro';
681:       return 'orin_default';
682:     case 'sela': return q.isCompleted('main_awakening') ? 'sela_default' : 'sela_intro';
683:     case 'elna':
684:       if (q.isActive('side_lilies') && q.stageIndex('side_lilies') === 1) return 'elna_lilies_complete';
685:       if (q.isCompleted('side_lilies')) return 'elna_default';
686:       return 'elna_intro';
687:     case 'tilo':
688:       if (q.isActive('side_echo') && q.stageIndex('side_echo') === 1) return 'tilo_echo_complete';
689:       if (q.isCompleted('side_echo')) return 'tilo_default';
690:       return 'tilo_intro';
691:     case 'roderic': return flags['gem1'] ? 'roderic_intro' : 'roderic_gate_locked';
692:     case 'kael':
693:       if (q.isActive('side_survivors') && q.stageIndex('side_survivors') === 1) return 'kael_survivors_complete';
694:       if (q.isActive('main_drakmor') && flags['dama-choice']) return 'kael_after_dama';
695:       if (!flags['kael_met']) return 'kael_intro';
696:       return 'kael_default';
697:     case 'nira':
698:       if (q.isActive('side_obsidian') && q.stageIndex('side_obsidian') === 1) return 'nira_golems_complete';
699:       return 'nira_intro';
700:     case 'survivor1': return 'survivor1';
701:     case 'survivor2': return 'survivor2';
702:     case 'survivor3': return 'survivor3';
703:     case 'survivor4': return 'survivor4';
704:     case 'aurel':
705:       if (q.isActive('side_balance') && q.stageIndex('side_balance') === 1) return 'aurel_balance';
706:       if (!flags['aurel_met']) return 'aurel_intro';
707:       return 'aurel_default';
708:     case 'vela':
709:       if (q.isActive('side_garden') && q.stageIndex('side_garden') === 1) return 'vela_garden';
710:       return 'vela_intro';
711:     case 'echo': return 'echo_final';
712:     default: return null;
713:   }
714: }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a real, playable Spanish-language fantasy action RPG called **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL** in the existing static web project, with Android/mobile support, aiming for exceptional quality (GOTY as aspiration, not a claim).
- The user’s prompt is in Spanish and was cut off mid-sentence; current scope includes character customization, three regions, story, combat, creatures, exploration, UI, audio, and polish.

## Requirements
- Name: **LA ESPADA CELESTIAL**; genre: action RPG, medieval fantasy, adventure, exploration, combat, creature collection.
- Android priority, horizontal orientation, Spanish from Spain, cinematic fantasy/anime aesthetic, original IP.
- Real playable game, not a mockup, design bible, or decorative demo.
- Regions: **VALDORIA**, **DRAKMOR**, **KANSORDORE**.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothing, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte with measurable effects; equipment affects stats and appearance; distinct animations.
- Story must be original, coherent, mysterious, with choices, consequences, memorable characters, and a satisfying ending.
- No false GOTY claims.
- Existing runtime serves a static `index.html` or Vite project; `capture.sh` auto-clicks a single visible button labeled `Start`/`Play` (English) then screenshots desktop 1440×900 and mobile 390×844 after 1s.
- Mobile browser support: responsive layouts, usable touch controls, safe areas, no browser gesture conflicts, iOS motion permission only from user gesture if tilt is used.

## Decisions
- Build a **2D top-down action RPG using Canvas 2D + DOM UI**, plain ES modules, no external runtime dependencies, served statically.
- Use procedural art and synthesized WebAudio music/SFX; downloaded local fonts (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`).
- Title screen uses a Spanish `JUGAR` button with `aria-label="Play"` so automated capture finds it; title also offers `CREAR PERSONAJE`, `CONTINUAR`, and `AJUSTES`.
- `JUGAR` starts gameplay directly with a default character so automated capture sees actual gameplay; character creator remains accessible via the prominent `CREAR PERSONAJE` button.
- Gameplay shows a rotate-device hint in portrait after ~1.8s delay (so capture at ~1s still shows gameplay); creator remains usable in portrait.
- Implement three regions, 12 collectible “Resonancias,” 11 normal enemy types, 3 bosses, 3 endings, 12 skill nodes, equipment, shops, forge, quests, codex, map, save slots, settings, accessibility, and PWA support.
- Story final choice: **Restaurar el Velo**, **Romper el Velo**, or **Convergencia Absoluta**.
- `main_awakening` starts automatically; main quests chain via `next`.
- Boss doors require puzzle flags (`val-puzzle`, `drak-runes`, `kan-library` + 3 pages).
- Plan to deliver as a mobile-friendly PWA/browser game; native APK packaging is not currently implemented and should be explained as a limitation if relevant.
- Art system split into `src/render/sprites/{common,terrain,props,characters,enemies,portraits}.js`; barrel export added at `src/render/sprites.js`.
- UI is DOM-driven, built dynamically by `src/ui/ui.js`; title/creator/HUD/dialogue markup and screens are in `index.html`; visual system in `styles.css`.
- New `src/ui/ui.js` implements title/creator binding, character creator state/preview, HUD sync, dialogue typewriter/choices, pause menu, inventory/stats/resonance panels, skills, journal, codex, map, settings, shop, forge, save/load, help, lore, death/ending screens, toasts, and orientation handling.

"LA ESPADA CELESTIAL
ENCARGO MAESTRO DEFINITIVO PARA IA GAME LAB
RPG DE FANTASÍA ÉPICA — OBJETIVO: ASPIRAR A GOTY
INSTRUCCIÓN PRINCIPAL:
Quiero que desarrolles LA ESPADA CELESTIAL, un videojuego RPG de fantasía medieval, acción, aventura, exploración y criaturas coleccionables. No quiero una simple demostración, una maqueta, una presentación, una biblia de diseño ni un escenario con botones decorativos. Quiero un videojuego real, jugable, funcional, profundo, original y profesional.
La ambición es crear un título capaz de competir algún día entre los mejores videojuegos del mundo y aspirar al premio GOTY (Game of the Year).
No afirmes que el juego ha ganado o merece un premio sin haberlo conseguido. El GOTY es nuestro objetivo de excelencia, no una promesa.
Debes trabajar sobre las capacidades reales de IA Game Lab, inspeccionar el proyecto existente y utilizar las herramientas disponibles para construir el juego. No inventes funciones que la plataforma no pueda ejecutar. Si algo no es posible, explica la limitación y desarrolla la mejor alternativa técnica.
---
1. IDENTIDAD DEL VIDEOJUEGO
Nombre: LA ESPADA CELESTIAL.
Género: RPG de acción, fantasía medieval, aventura, exploración, combate y colección de criaturas.
Plataforma prioritaria: Android.
Orientación: Horizontal.
Idioma: Español de España.
Estética: Fantasía medieval cinematográfica con personalidad anime, escenarios detallados, iluminación espectacular, personajes originales y efectos visuales de alta calidad.
Inspiración: La profundidad de los grandes RPG, la libertad de exploración de las aventuras clásicas y la emoción de coleccionar criaturas, sin copiar personajes, diseños, música, historias ni propiedades intelectuales existentes.
El juego debe tener identidad propia y ser reconocible por su universo, personajes, criaturas, música y dirección artística.
---
2. OBJETIVO DE CALIDAD: NIVEL GOTY
Diseña y desarrolla el juego siguiendo estándares de excelencia en:
Jugabilidad.
Combate.
Historia.
Personajes.
Mundo.
Exploración.
Diseño artístico.
Música y sonido.
Animaciones.
Inteligencia artificial.
Interfaz y controles.
Rendimiento.
Accesibilidad.
Profundidad de sistemas.
Originalidad.
Cada sistema debe aportar algo al conjunto.
No quiero cantidad sin calidad.
No quiero un mundo enorme vacío, enemigos repetidos, misiones genéricas ni habilidades que no tengan utilidad.
Quiero una experiencia memorable.
---
3. UNIVERSO E HISTORIA
El mundo está formado por regiones conectadas por una historia épica.
Región inicial: VALDORIA
Una tierra de aldeas, bosques, praderas, ríos, montañas, ruinas y antiguas civilizaciones.
Aquí comienza la aventura.
Región de DRAKMOR
Territorios volcánicos, fortalezas, ciudades devastadas, bosques oscuros y criaturas corrompidas.
Región de KANSORDORE
Templos celestiales, ciudades antiguas, bibliotecas prohibidas, dimensiones alternativas y misterios relacionados con el origen del mundo.
Elementos fundamentales de la historia
La Gema Celestial.
La Jarra de Origen.
La Lágrima de la Primera Brasa.
La Profecía de Jugador Cero.
La Convergencia Absoluta.
El Despertar.
La Resonancia.
El Velo.
La Ruptura.
La Ascensión.
Construye una historia original, coherente y emocionante, con misterios, revelaciones, conflictos, decisiones, consecuencias, personajes memorables y un final satisfactorio.
No reveles todos los misterios al principio.
La historia debe desarrollarse mediante acontecimientos jugables, diálogos, exploración y escenas cinematográficas.
---
4. PROTAGONISTA
Crear un protagonista personalizable.
Permitir configurar, según las posibilidades técnicas:
Nombre.
Rostro.
Pelo.
Color de pelo.
Ropa.
Armadura.
Casco.
Accesorios.
Armas.
Estadísticas
Vida.
Maná.
Resistencia.
Fuerza.
Defensa.
Velocidad.
Inteligencia.
Suerte.
Cada atributo debe tener efectos medibles.
El equipamiento debe modificar las estadísticas y, cuando sea viable, la apariencia del personaje.
Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi
"

Quiero que desarrolles LA ESPADA CELESTIAL, un videojuego RPG de fantasía medieval, acción, aventura, exploración y criaturas coleccionables. No quiero una simple demostración, una maqueta, una presentación, una biblia de diseño ni un escenario con botones decorativos. Quiero un videojuego real, jugable, funcional, profundo, original y profesional.
La ambición es crear un título capaz de competir algún día entre los mejores videojuegos del mundo y aspirar al premio GOTY (Game of the Year).
No afirmes que el juego ha ganado o merece un premio sin haberlo conseguido. El GOTY es nuestro objetivo de excelencia, no una promesa.
Debes trabajar sobre las capacidades reales de IA Game Lab, inspeccionar el proyecto existente y utilizar las herramientas disponibles para construir el juego. No inventes funciones que la plataforma no pueda ejecutar. Si algo no es posible, explica la limitación y desarrolla la mejor alternativa técnica.
---
1. IDENTIDAD DEL VIDEOJUEGO
Nombre: LA ESPADA CELESTIAL.
Género: RPG de acción, fantasía medieval, aventura, exploración, combate y colección de criaturas.
Plataforma prioritaria: Android.
Orientación: Horizontal.
Idioma: Español de España.
Estética: Fantasía medieval cinematográfica con personalidad anime, escenarios detallados, iluminación espectacular, personajes originales y efectos visuales de alta calidad.
Inspiración: La profundidad de los grandes RPG, la libertad de exploración de las aventuras clásicas y la emoción de coleccionar criaturas, sin copiar personajes, diseños, música, historias ni propiedades intelectuales existentes.
El juego debe tener identidad propia y ser reconocible por su universo, personajes, criaturas, música y dirección artística.
---
2. OBJETIVO DE CALIDAD: NIVEL GOTY
Diseña y desarrolla el juego siguiendo estándares de excelencia en:
Jugabilidad.
Combate.
Historia.
Personajes.
Mundo.
Exploración.
Diseño artístico.
Música y sonido.
Animaciones.
Inteligencia artificial.
Interfaz y controles.
Rendimiento.
Accesibilidad.
Profundidad de sistemas.
Originalidad.
Cada sistema debe aportar algo al conjunto.
No quiero cantidad sin calidad.
No quiero un mundo enorme vacío, enemigos repetidos, misiones genéricas ni habilidades que no tengan utilidad.
Quiero una experiencia memorable.
---
3. UNIVERSO E HISTORIA
El mundo está formado por regiones conectadas por una historia épica.
Región inicial: VALDORIA
Una tierra de aldeas, bosques, praderas, ríos, montañas, ruinas y antiguas civilizaciones.
Aquí comienza la aventura.
Región de DRAKMOR
Territorios volcánicos, fortalezas, ciudades devastadas, bosques oscuros y criaturas corrompidas.
Región de KANSORDORE
Templos celestiales, ciudades antiguas, bibliotecas prohibidas, dimensiones alternativas y misterios relacionados con el origen del mundo.
Elementos fundamentales de la historia
La Gema Celestial.
La Jarra de Origen.
La Lágrima de la Primera Brasa.
La Profecía de Jugador Cero.
La Convergencia Absoluta.
El Despertar.
La Resonancia.
El Velo.
La Ruptura.
La Ascensión.
Construye una historia original, coherente y emocionante, con misterios, revelaciones, conflictos, decisiones, consecuencias, personajes memorables y un final satisfactorio.
No reveles todos los misterios al principio.
La historia debe desarrollarse mediante acontecimientos jugables, diálogos, exploración y escenas cinematográficas.
---
4. PROTAGONISTA
Crear un protagonista personalizable.
Permitir configurar, según las posibilidades técnicas:
Nombre.
Rostro.
Pelo.
Color de pelo.
Ropa.
Armadura.
Casco.
Accesorios.
Armas.
Estadísticas
Vida.
Maná.
Resistencia.
Fuerza.
Defensa.
Velocidad.
Inteligencia.
Suerte.
Cada atributo debe tener efectos medibles.
El equipamiento debe modificar las estadísticas y, cuando sea viable, la apariencia del personaje.
